panels.title: Who talks to whom (from the kernel, no app instrumentation)
Service map: flows in the time range

targets.rawSql: SELECT src, dst, formatReadableSize(sum(delta)) AS bytes, round(sum(delta) / greatest(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime), 1)) AS bytes_per_s FROM (SELECT concat(Attributes['k8s.src.namespace'], '/', Attributes['k8s.src.owner.name']) AS src, concat(Attributes['k8s.dst.namespace'], '/', Attributes['k8s.dst.owner.name']) AS dst, Attributes AS series, max(Value) - min(Value) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'obi.network.flow.bytes' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY src, dst, series) GROUP BY src, dst HAVING sum(delta) > 0 ORDER BY sum(delta) DESC LIMIT 40

panels.description: Each row is a pod-owner -> pod-owner flow seen by eBPF traffic-control hooks. '/obs' is the node itself.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, flow, sum(rate) AS bytes_per_s FROM ( SELECT time, flow, series, greatest(v - lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(concat(Attributes['k8s.src.namespace'], '/', Attributes['k8s.src.owner.name']), ' -> ', concat(Attributes['k8s.dst.namespace'], '/', Attributes['k8s.dst.owner.name'])) AS flow, Attributes AS series, max(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'obi.network.flow.bytes' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, flow, series)) WHERE flow IN (SELECT concat(concat(Attributes['k8s.src.namespace'], '/', Attributes['k8s.src.owner.name']), ' -> ', concat(Attributes['k8s.dst.namespace'], '/', Attributes['k8s.dst.owner.name'])) AS f FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'obi.network.flow.bytes' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY f ORDER BY max(Value) DESC LIMIT 8) GROUP BY time, flow ORDER BY time

SELECT src_ns, dst_ns, formatReadableSize(sum(delta)) AS bytes FROM ( SELECT Attributes['k8s.src.namespace'] AS src_ns, Attributes['k8s.dst.namespace'] AS dst_ns, Attributes AS series, max(Value) - min(Value) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'obi.network.flow.bytes' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY src_ns, dst_ns, series) GROUP BY src_ns, dst_ns HAVING sum(delta) > 0 ORDER BY sum(delta) DESC

SELECT src AS talker, sum(delta) AS bytes FROM ( SELECT concat(Attributes['k8s.src.namespace'], '/', Attributes['k8s.src.owner.name']) AS src, Attributes AS series, max(Value) - min(Value) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'obi.network.flow.bytes' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY src, series) GROUP BY talker ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 10

options.content:
**Network flows** come from OBI's kernel traffic-control (tc) hooks and work on minikube.

**Zero-code request tracing** (spans / RED metrics for Grafana, Prometheus, ClickHouse) needs the `security_socket_accept` kernel hook, which the WSL2 kernel lacks (`CONFIG_SECURITY_NETWORK` off). It works on a standard Linux kernel, e.g. the Lambda GPU node (`deploy/cloud/lambda`).
